_comment: Drives the Reels and From the Institute grids on gallery.html. Leave a list empty and that section shows its 'nothing here yet' message instead of a broken grid, so the page is safe to ship before there is content. Add entries in the order you want them displayed.

_reels_fields.url: required, the Instagram post or reel permalink, opens in a new tab
_reels_fields.thumb: required, a local image path such as gallery/reel-01.jpg; save a still from the reel at roughly 800x1000
_reels_fields.title: optional, short bold line under the card
_reels_fields.caption: optional, one grey line under the title

_internal_fields.url: optional; omit and the card is not a link
_internal_fields.thumb: required, a local image path such as gallery/talk-bangkok.jpg
_internal_fields.title: optional
_internal_fields.caption: optional, a good place for the event and date
